newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian shares plunge 8.6 pct on political crisis.
newsitem.headline: Indian shares plunge 8.6 pct on political crisis.

text.p: Indian shares plunged more than eight percent in panicky trade on Monday, as investors sold after the Congress Party on Sunday withdrew make-or-break support to the ruling coalition, traders said.
"People are having a big panic," said a chief dealer at a foreign institutional investor.
Bombay's benchmark stocks index dived 313.50 points, or 8.56 percent, to 3350.03 minutes after opening.

Traders said investors and speculators were sellers as India hurtled into political crisis after the Congress party abruptly withdrew pivotal support for Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's 10-month-old coalition government.
